newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline firm.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Monday, with gasoline firmer and gas oil weaker.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were unchanged and untraded. Prices were assessed at around $87/$89 fob ARA.

Gasoline levels were well up on Friday close values, with second half July Eurograde barge trades earlier in the morning at $190.25, $192.50 and $193 being followed by a first half August deal at $190.50.
Dealers could see no fresh direction to the market by lunchtime Monday and were awaiting to take their cue from afternoon NYMEX activity.
Products brokers saw naphtha swap values falling sharply by late morning to $186.50-$187.50 for August, $3 lower than Friday.
The swap ideas reflected the fact that physical quotes were placed at $186-$191 CIF NWE amid scepticism over bid and offer levels as high as $194-$195 circulating Friday.
Gas oil eased 25 cents a tonne in line with the IPE August contract which was trading at $163.25. Spreads were steady to slightly easier but activity was thin.
